pendingNotices.title: Rapid Mobilization — units moved to base
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player moved 1 unit from Alderaan into the hidden Rebel Base. The base itself did NOT move — Rapid Mobilization's other option (establish a new base) was not used, so no probe card changes hands and Alderaan remains a possible base location.

payload.title: Death Star Plans — no fighter left to make the run

payload.reason: The Empire cannot retreat while a Death Star or Death Star Under Construction is in the battle.
None of your units here can leave on their own — retreating needs a ship that can fly itself out (fighters, ground units and immobile units cannot).
Retreating means marching a leader out of the system, and you have no leader here — so these units have to stand and fight.

pendingNotices.title: Death Star Plans — no fighter left to make the run
pendingNotices.details: Death Star Plans needs at least 1 of your FIGHTERS (X-Wing, Y-Wing or U-Wing) still alive when the space battle step ends. Capital ships don't qualify, however many survive, and destroying the Death Star's escorts doesn't help if your fighters die doing it. The card stays in your hand — the window is re-checked after the space step of every round.
